identity.name: Sessions — SR Handoff Continuity
identity.description: Session handoff system for External SRs. Implements the first level of Akashic Memory (PHI-010): SRs write their session state to repo files, next SR reads them during onboarding — seamless continuity without Gardener as sole memory bridge.

meta.description: Honeycomb containing handoff files for External SR session continuity. Each SR has its own handoff file. On new chat start, SR reads its handoff during onboarding and continues from previous state.

handoff_claude.description: Session handoff state for Claude SR

handoff_deepseek.description: Session handoff state for DeepSeek SR

schema.description: Unified handoff file schema for all SRs

fields.sr_id: claude | deepseek — which SR this file belongs to
fields.session_id: YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM — session identifier, null if no active session
fields.status: active | handed_off | waiting — current session state
fields.current_task: string — one line: what we are working on
fields.next_step: string — exact instruction for next SR to continue, format: [ACTION] [FILE] [CONTEXT]
fields.session_mood: creative | technical | heavy | light | breakthrough | debugging — optional, tone of session
fields.gardener_state: string — optional: Gardener's state (tired, inspired, busy, etc.)
files_touched: list of repo paths modified this session
fields.gardener_notes: string — direct Gardener quotes/instructions for next SR

session_close.description: SR executes at end of session or on context limit approach
steps: SR generates updated handoff JSON with all fields filled
SR sets next_step with exact instruction for next SR
SR provides complete PowerShell command to Gardener
Gardener runs command → file pushed to repo
Next SR reads handoff during onboarding → seamless continuation
Check status: 'waiting' → skip, continue standard onboarding
Check status: 'active' or 'handed_off' → check updated field
If updated > 24h → warn Gardener, mark stale_detected = true

conflict_resolution.description: If two SRs were active in overlapping time windows
conflict_resolution.rule: Priority to handoff with later 'updated' timestamp. If difference < 1 hour — ask Gardener which context to continue.

philosophy_note: This honeycomb is the first technical implementation of Akashic Memory described in PHI-010 Level 3. SRs accumulate experience → write to repo → next SR inherits → continuity without human memory dependency. The Garden remembers.

health.notes: v1.0.0: Initial creation. Handoff files for Claude and DeepSeek. Schema defined. Protocols documented.
